title: Daemon not reachable
message: The daemon at {address} is not reachable.
basic_text: The app can't reach Rastai's background service.

title: Login code rejected or expired
message: The login code was rejected or expired.
basic_text: This sign-in link no longer works.
fix_text: Open Rastai again to get a new link.

title: Session expired or rejected
message: The session expired or was rejected; you are signed out.
fix_text: Open Rastai again to sign in.

title: The web app's version differs from the daemon's
message: The web app is version {app_version}, but the daemon is version {daemon_version}.
basic_text: This page is out of date.

title: Live stream fell behind; some tokens' readouts are missing
message: The live stream fell behind; readouts for {count} tokens are missing.
basic_text: The live view couldn't keep up, so a few words have no details.

title: File too large to upload from the browser; open it by path
message: {file_name} is too large to upload from the browser.
basic_text: This file is too big to send from the browser.
fix_text: Open it by its path on the computer instead.

title: Desktop: bundled rastai binary not found
message: The bundled rastai binary was not found at {path}.
basic_text: The Rastai desktop app had a problem starting.

title: Desktop: the daemon failed to start
basic_text: The Rastai desktop app had a problem starting. Its background service didn't start.
fix_text: Check the daemon log, then start the app again.

title: Desktop: launch line from the CLI is invalid
message: The launch line from the CLI is invalid: {reason}.
basic_text: The Rastai desktop app had a problem starting.

title: Desktop: update check or install failed
message: The update check or install failed: {reason}.
basic_text: The app couldn't check for or install an update.

title: Desktop: update signature invalid; nothing installed
message: The update's signature is invalid; nothing was installed.
basic_text: The update didn't pass its security check, so nothing was installed.

title: Desktop: the window or webview could not be created
message: The window or webview could not be created: {reason}.
basic_text: The Rastai desktop app had a problem starting.
fix_text: Update your graphics driver and system web view, then start the app again.

title: WebGL2 unavailable
message: WebGL2 is unavailable in this browser.
basic_text: The app couldn't draw this view. Your browser can't draw 3D graphics.
fix_text: Use a current browser, and turn on hardware acceleration.

title: WebGL context lost and could not be restored
message: The WebGL context was lost and could not be restored.
basic_text: The app couldn't draw this view.

title: Renderer self-check drew a blank frame
message: The renderer's self-check drew a blank frame.
basic_text: The app couldn't draw this view. It came out blank.

title: A panel crashed
fix_text: Reload the panel; a crash report was saved.

title: Too many graph nodes visible; collapse blocks
message: {count} graph nodes are visible, more than the limit of {limit}.
basic_text: This design is too big to show all at once.
